exact_duplicate_check.scope: Recognized labeled maps only; 2D, values in {0,1,2}, and at least one valid die. Original shape and values, before resizing.
exact_duplicate_check.hash_method: BLAKE2b-128 over little-endian uint32 shape followed by row-major uint8 values; hash equality is used for grouping.

example_selection.method: Uniform reservoir sample per class with independent NumPy random streams; samples are illustrative real observations, not selected for typicality or prediction outcome.
example_selection.eligibility: 2D nonempty map; all values in {0,1,2}; at least one valid die; recognized class label.

notes: The original lowercase label 'none' is displayed as 'None'. Missing labels are a separate category.
None denotes no labeled systematic failure pattern, not necessarily zero failing dies.
zero_failing_die_map is descriptive, not automatically an invalid record.
Original trainTestLabel values are reported for auditing only; no new train/validation/test split has been made.
No resizing, augmentation, model training, attacks, or predictions were performed.
record_origin: Saved dataset audit; path labels normalized for public distribution.
